summaries.Romania: Romania's economy showed tentative recovery with 2.1% Q3 growth, marking the second-best performance in the EU, though annual figures remain negative. Political tensions escalated as PSD faces criticism over governance while pushing administrative reforms, with mounting STB transport system dysfunction dominating headlines.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focuses on AI integration for clinical workflows and patient data management, while research funding expands into psychedelic treatments for PTSD and brain-computer interfaces face regulatory pauses. Cost pressures persist as insurers and providers navigate conflicts of interest and emerging care models.
summaries.Tech: Microsoft's global Outlook outage exposed cloud infrastructure vulnerabilities affecting millions, while Nvidia's Jensen Huang resignation amid scandal triggered leadership uncertainty and congressional investigations into the company's China dealings. Apple launched HomeView and new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI, advancing its smart home ambitions as AI capabilities rapidly evolve across the industry.

items.title: Dyania Health, Nvidia team up to bring clinical reasoning AI inside hospital networks
items.snippet: Dyania Health is teaming up with Nvidia to run its Synapsis AI clinical reasoning platform inside hospitals’ own IT environments, allowing health systems to analyze years of patient records at population scale without sending protected patient data outside their networks.
items.line: Dyania Health partners with Nvidia to run clinical AI inside hospitals' private networks, protecting patient data while enabling population-scale analysis—a critical shift for healthcare AI adoption.

items.title: Is AI Really Saving Hospitals Money? A New Study Raises Questions About the Cost of AI-Driven Care
items.snippet:
Healthcare systems are investing in AI to streamline workflows and save money, but a new study in the New England Journal of Medicine shows that AI-generated care plans might actually cost far more than those ordered by physicians.

items.line: NEJM study reveals AI-generated care plans cost significantly more than physician orders, challenging cost-savings narratives and highlighting implementation risks for health systems.

items.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline

items.title: Remus Borza anunță concedieri la STB în 2027 / „Logica este să scăpăm de niște oameni care au călcat pe bec și să aducem alții curați”
items.snippet: STB va trece printr-o nouă etapă de concedieri la începutul anului 2027. items.line: STB administrator Borza plans cuts to 7,000 employees and proposes 66% fare increases, signaling deep structural reforms needed but facing political resistance and public backlash.

items.title: Zus Health secures $33M to build the infrastructure for AI-powered clinical workflows
items.snippet: As healthcare companies race to build AI copilots and agents, startup Zus Health is betting that the bigger opportunity is creating the connected patient data layer those applications need to work reliably.
items.line: Zus Health's $33M funding to build connected patient data infrastructure positions the startup as essential middleware for healthcare AI agents and clinical workflows.

items.title: STAT+: HHS plans funding for research into ibogaine for PTSD
items.snippet: The Trump administration will funnel up to $4.9 million into supporting research into ibogaine, a psychedelic that’s drawn interest as a potential treatment for PTSD and addiction.
items.line: Trump administration allocates $4.9M to ibogaine PTSD research, signaling regulatory openness to psychedelics despite earlier restrictions and marking policy shift on mental health innovation.
